questions.stem_text: In a forest, how do decomposers help other organisms survive?

options.A: They release oxygen into the air that animals breathe.
options.B: They put nutrients into the soil that plants use to grow.
options.C: They provide shelter in forests where animals can hide.
options.D: They use sunlight to make food for plants and animals.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - They put nutrients into the soil that plants use to grow.
